name: MyCase
description: MyCase is cloud legal practice-management software for cases, contacts, calendars, tasks, documents, billing, payments, client communications, intake, and firm workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a current bearer token issued for the customer firm through MyCase Open API onboarding. Agents can run one approval-gated authority check that validates the authorized firm transiently and returns no firm identity, user identity, case, contact, document, calendar, task, billing, payment, intake, or communication data.

credentialRequirements.name: MYCASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: MyCase Open API access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Supply a current bearer token issued through MyCase Open API onboarding for the exact customer firm. Relay encrypts it and never returns it to agents.

capabilities.label: Verify connection authority
capabilities.description: Verify that the supplied token resolves to an authorized MyCase firm while returning no firm identity or legal-practice data.

approvalRequired.label: Verify MyCase connection authority
approvalRequired.description: Call only the fixed authorized-firm endpoint, validate a firm identifier in memory, discard the complete response, and return authorization and redaction status.

blocked.label: Access identity, firm, contact, or case data
blocked.description: Firm and user identity, contacts, companies, clients, cases, stages, relationships, custom fields, and related legal-practice records are blocked.

blocked.label: Access documents, calendars, tasks, or communications
blocked.description: Documents, folders, events, calendars, tasks, notes, emails, messages, portal activity, intake, and communications are blocked.

blocked.label: Access financial data, write, or administer MyCase
blocked.description: Time, expenses, invoices, billing, payments, trust data, creates, updates, deletes, uploads, webhooks, users, tokens, settings, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API, pagination, or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, methods, identifiers, queries, bodies, pagination, polling, retries, raw responses, browser sessions, bulk operations, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The identity-free authority check requires approval; all firm identity, legal-practice data, communications, financial data, writes, administration, raw APIs, pagination, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same authority check runs directly; exact firm ownership, credential secrecy, fixed endpoint, redaction, auditing, response bounds, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed identity-free MyCase authority wrapper with encrypted customer credentials.
Hermes receives the same fixed identity-free MyCase authority wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: MyCase Open API is available only on the Advanced tier and access must be enabled through MyCase support for the subscribing firm; a current customer-issued bearer token, exact firm authorization, rotation ownership, security/privacy review, and live acceptance remain required.
providerSetup.nextAction: A firm administrator confirms the Advanced tier, asks MyCase support to enable Open API access, obtains a current token for the exact firm outside Relay, stores it through Relay's encrypted credential flow, and completes a live authority, expiration, rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect-denial check.

evidence.supports: MyCase states that Open API is exclusive to the Advanced tier, directs firms to its API documentation, and requires contacting MyCase support to gain access.
The official MyCase Open API documentation defines its per-firm onboarding, bearer-token API, and authorized-firm resource; Relay uses only that authority resource.
The official reference documents the read-only endpoint for the firm of the current authorized user; Relay validates its identifier transiently and discards the response.
MyCase positions Open API as the connection surface for subscribing firms' internal and third-party platforms and separately invites paid integration partnerships.
The official software partner program documents annual fees and approval requirements; Relay therefore does not assume a paid Relay-owned partner commitment.

securityNotes: The customer-issued access token is encrypted as a secret reference and sent only as a Bearer credential to the fixed external-integrations.mycase.com origin; it is never returned to agents.

Relay allowlists only GET https://external-integrations.mycase.com/v1/firm, rejects redirects, waits 20 seconds, caps the response at 1 MB, accepts no runtime input, and never paginates or retries automatically.
The connector validates only that a firm identifier exists, discards the complete provider response, and returns authorized, API version, and redaction status without firm or user identity.

Cases, contacts, companies, relationships, documents, events, tasks, communications, intake, time, billing, payments, writes, webhooks, administration, raw APIs, pagination, bulk, and exports are structurally unavailable.
Token issuance, capture, refresh or replacement, Advanced-tier entitlement, support enablement, exact firm consent, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
